data_classification: synthetic demonstration only; aggregate desk-day counts, no patient-level records

grains.RAW.DESKS: one row per coordination desk (city and service line)
grains.RAW.DESK_DAILY: one row per desk per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.COMPLIANCE_DOCUMENTS: one row per desk (desk document snapshot)
grains.CURATED.ISSUE_SUMMARY: one row per journey issue type

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day group-wide journey-issue FORECAST; payment guarantee decline rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.ISSUE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic, administrative journey-issue handling SOPs (one per service line and issue type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.PATIENT_JOURNEY_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.PATIENT_JOURNEY_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, desk, issue-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (desks, daily journey issues, cancelled appointments by desk, appointment-cancellation risk, appointment booking events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_BOOKINGS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_BOOKING_ALERT logs new ISSUE events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)
required_capabilities.cancel_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(cancelled appointment at the desk in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
